all_words.explanation: A simile and a metaphor are both figures of speech that create meaning through comparison, so the two words are close in meaning.
A lantern is a source of light and has no connection to figurative language.
Imagery is one of the main tools used to build a metaphor, so the two words belong to the same topic of literary style.
A tractor is a farm vehicle and is unrelated to literary style.
A metaphor is usually described as figurative language, so the two words often appear together.
A kettle is a household appliance and is unrelated to figurative language.

explanation: A metaphor creates meaning through implied comparison, using imagery and figurative language; the other words belong to unrelated fields.
